description: A front-facing wrap robe has broad sleeves, overlapping diagonal lapels, and a flared knee-length body. A belt crosses the waist with two loose ends hanging down, while the overlapping front opening continues to the hem.
A person sits in profile facing right on a low bench, with a bent arm resting near the lap and legs extending downward. Three tall wavy heat trails rise in the open space beside the head.

A front-facing person with a circular head and rounded shoulders stands within an open oval pool outline. The torso narrows below the shoulders, and paired wavy steam trails rise on either side of the head.

An upright bamboo stalk has gently concave sides and two horizontal joints dividing its length. A short branch grows from the right side, carrying one upward-pointing leaf and one leaf extending horizontally.

Three smooth rounded stones balance vertically, with each stone smaller than the one beneath it. The broad bottom stone supports a medium oval stone and a rounded top stone, forming a centred tapered stack.

Three flattened oval stones balance in a centred vertical stack, decreasing in width toward the top. The upper stone is especially shallow, and the overlapping curved edges distinguish the three separate stones.

A front-facing upper-body figure has an oval featureless head and gently sloping shoulders. The wrap robe crosses diagonally over the chest, with short vertical sleeve seams framing the open lower torso.
